people.name: Baanah
people.line: A captain who murdered Ish-bosheth, Saul's son.

people.name: Beeroth
people.line: Hivite city, later allotted to Benjamin.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Rechab
people.line: A captain of Ishbosheth's army, with his brother Baanah

people.name: Rimmon
people.line: Father of Baanah and Rechab, murderers of Ish-bosheth

translations.web: David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, “As Yahweh lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,
translations.bsb: But David answered Rechab and his brother Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, “As surely as the LORD lives, who has redeemed my life from all distress,
translations.kjv: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said unto them, As the LORD liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,
translations.asv: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said unto them, As Jehovah liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,
